title: 第16章 合成百年锻灵草第17章 灵根提升银蛇相邀
slug: 人在废丹房我九阳圣体凭丹近神
content_zh:
;;
在李安那带着质问的目光注视下，银蛇顿了片刻，这才用逐渐恢复的微弱的神识给李安传音，
“火灵脉附近……有我母亲此前……留下的巢穴，其中有地火的存在……”
听完银蛇的传音，李安顿时明白了银蛇的想法和意图。
地火除却可以帮助炼丹之外，还有着种种玄异之处，淬炼灵气，稳固根基，就是其中一种。
想要成为筑基修士，最起码也得精炼出六品灵气才行。
而想要更高品阶的筑基，那就得三品灵气以上。
而他现在，也就修行出了八品上的灵魄之气。
依靠地火淬炼，稳固根基，精炼灵气，这无疑非常合适。
其他修士可没有自己这么多丹药可以吞服，根本坚持不了多久，就会灵气耗尽，无法长时间接受地火淬炼。
可他有丹药，可以依靠丹药的药力强撑。
只是，这银蛇只怕是隐瞒了什么。
这件事情要是真的这么简单，银蛇绝对早就依靠地火，极大的提升了境界和实力。
不至于现在都还只是炼气三层。
随着李安质疑的眼神看来，蛇妖也是略微有些尴尬。
它说的全都是真的，只是它母亲死后，它实力不够，巢穴已经被更为强大的火尾鼠给占据了。
火尾鼠天生就喜欢炙热的地方。
虽然它们单个的实力并不强，可是因为血脉特殊，体内天生有一缕兽火，相互之间能产生极大的共鸣。
使得实力暴涨。
不然它也不会主动放弃，转而四处逃窜，寻找修行资源。

它简单的给李安解释了一下，李安想了想，除却对地火有兴趣，对那火尾鼠，也是有了一些兴趣，
“说说吧，那些火尾鼠的数量，以及它们当中的最强存在，如今的实力如何？”
见李安对这件事情很上心，银蛇顿时将它所知道的消息，一股脑的告知给李安。
而李安闻言之后，也是对那些火尾鼠有了一些了解。
为首的火尾鼠，已经达到了炼气三层。
在其他火尾鼠的共鸣帮助下，可以达到堪比炼气四层的程度，这一份实力，在外门当中，都算得上是较为强大之辈。
唯有管事以及那些外门天骄能稳稳压其一头。
他现在的境界虽然到了三阶巅峰，又有更为强大的八品上灵魄之气，但是境界的差距，以及火尾鼠群依靠兽火产生的共鸣。
却让李安颇为的警惕。
银蛇的血脉术法不凡，可都是在对方身上吃瘪，那些妖兽绝对不简单。
何况这银蛇只怕还另有算计。
此事他暂且记下，并未第一时间答应与银蛇之间的合作。
“地火……你我共有……”
银蛇继续给李安传音，希望李安可以一起合作。
李安却不为所动，只是默默运转功法，精炼灵气和灵魂。
银蛇对此很是不理解，“你如今的实力不俗……”
他们联手之下，必然可以杀得火尾鼠仓皇逃窜。
content_en:
;;
Under Li An's questioning gaze, Silver Snake paused for a moment, and then used his gradually recovering weak consciousness to send a message to Li An,
"Near the fire spirit vein... there is a nest left by my mother before... and there is earth fire in it..."
After listening to Yin She's voice transmission, Li An immediately understood Yin She's thoughts and intentions.
In addition to helping to refine elixirs, earth fire also has various mysterious properties. Tempering spiritual energy and stabilizing the foundation is one of them.
If you want to become a foundation-building monk, you must at least refine sixth-grade spiritual energy.
If you want to build a higher level of foundation, you need to have spiritual energy of level three or above.
And now, he has cultivated the spiritual energy of the eighth level.
Relying on the earth fire to temper, stabilize the foundation, and refine the spiritual energy is undoubtedly very suitable.
Other monks don't have as many pills to swallow as I do, and they won't be able to hold on for long before their spiritual energy is exhausted and they won't be able to be tempered by the earth fire for a long time.
But he has elixirs, and he can rely on the power of elixirs to support him.
However, this silver snake is probably hiding something.
If this matter was really that simple, Silver Snake would have definitely relied on Earth Fire to greatly improve its realm and strength.
It’s not like he is still at the third level of Qi Refining.
Following Li An's questioning eyes, the snake demon was also slightly embarrassed.
Everything it said was true, but after its mother died, it was not strong enough, and its nest had been occupied by the more powerful fire-tailed rat.
Fire-tailed rats naturally like hot places.
Although their individual strength is not strong, due to their special bloodline, they are born with a wisp of beast fire in their bodies, which can resonate greatly with each other.
causing the strength to skyrocket.
Otherwise, it would not give up voluntarily and instead run around looking for cultivation resources.
It briefly explained it to Li An. Li An thought about it and found that in addition to being interested in the earth fire, he also had some interest in the fire-tailed rat.
"Tell me, how many fire-tailed rats there are, and what is the current strength of the strongest among them?"
Seeing that Li An was very concerned about this matter, Silver Snake immediately informed Li An of all the news it knew.
After hearing this, Li An also gained some understanding of those fire-tailed rats.
The leader of the fire-tailed rats has reached the third level of Qi refining.
With the help of the resonance of other fire-tailed rats, it can reach a level comparable to the fourth level of Qi Refining. This strength is considered relatively powerful among the outer sects.
Only the stewards and those talented people from the outer sect can keep their head down.
Although his current realm has reached the peak of the third level, and he has a more powerful eighth-level spiritual energy, there is still a gap in realm, as well as the resonance generated by the fire-tailed rats relying on the beast fire.
But it made Li An quite wary.
Silver Snake's bloodline skills are extraordinary, but they are all defeated by the opponent. Those monsters are definitely not simple.
What's more, this Silver Snake may have other plans.
He kept this matter in mind for the time being and did not immediately agree to cooperate with Silver Snake.
"Earthfire...you and I share..."
Silver Snake continued to send messages to Li An, hoping that Li An could cooperate together.
Li An remained unmoved, and just silently operated his skills to refine his aura and soul.
Silver Snake didn't understand this very much, "Your current strength is quite good..."
If they join forces, they will definitely be able to kill the fire-tailed rats and make them run away in panic.
